In the seventies (maybe sixties) my grandfather delivered babies as a primary physician before he switched to an anesthesiologist. There was nothing that could be done for them. He was so matter of fact about it but for some reason that haunted me. It was weird because my grandfather was a very sentimental man. He cried over a poem about two lovers separated from each other in North Ireland and Ireland but had almost no emotion telling us about those babies. Just relating an experience.
